verdict.rationale: Ollama's own GitHub README directs users to "Run and chat with" a model, and a community benchmark confirms the terminal command 'ollama run' is used to run models with --verbose output. However, the evidence never explicitly describes an interactive terminal chat session, such as a REPL prompt, multi-turn conversation or in-session commands, so only part of the story is documented. missing for 10: explicit first-party CLI docs showing 'ollama run' opens an interactive multi-turn chat in the terminal, description of in-session controls or commands, independent hands-on corroboration of the interactive chat experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start an interactive chat session with a model directly from the terminal
